title: app-shell(metadata-admin): a spec-refused save served by the HTTP dispatcher shows `[object Object]` and an empty field path — `ResourceEditPage` reads `err.body.issues` / `err.body.error`, not the parsed `err.issues` / `err.message` (objectui#11302)
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect, class (a), a user-visible wrong result. `reach:` a named producer, measured: objectstack `@objectstack/runtime`'s meta save branch (write face `meta-dispatch`) answers a refused save through `errorFromThrown`, with `error` an object and the issues under `error.details.issues`. The wrong result was measured through the real `MetadataResourceEditPage`. Reader: triage first (grade and route). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_0122Knsowci76D2rBWReCzzZ`) from objectui#11302's dev report (`5930283862`, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`), judged fileable class (a) by PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11378's contract review (§③). ⛔ Not graded here.

Dedup: issue search over objectui for `ResourceEditPage`, `[object Object]`, `details.issues` and refused-save banner wording finds only objectui#11302 (the fields page, a different surface) and closed, unrelated objectui#4518 / objectui#4308 / objectui#4132.

## What happens

`MetadataClient.parseError` (`packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, `parseError`) already reads all three live error shapes. It sets `err.message` from `error.message` when `error` is an object, and `err.issues` from `error.details.issues` (the dispatcher shape) or top-level `issues` (the REST shape). Its own comment warns that `String(object)` yields `"[object Object]"`.

`ResourceEditPage.tsx`'s save `catch` (on `main` `20d23befe9`, about `:1548`–`:1566`) does not read those fields. Its `INVALID_METADATA` / 422 branch reads:
- `err?.body?.issues ?? []`, which is empty on the dispatcher shape because the issues sit under `body.error.details.issues`;
- then, finding no issues, `String(err?.body?.error ?? err?.message ?? '')`, which on the dispatcher shape is `String(object)`.

Measured by the objectui#11302 dev in a throwaway probe on the real page (the `ResourceEditPage.serverRefusalGate` harness), with the error `parseError` builds from the dispatcher envelope:
- the banner reads `[object Object]`;
- the Save button's title reads "The server refused this draft — fix  before saving." (`engine.validation.serverRefused` with an empty path);
- the issue's prescription text is absent.

Control on the same harness, with the REST shape (top-level `issues`, `error` a string): the issue message shows, and the title names the offending path.

## Same-family sites (one card covers them all)

Read on `main` `20d23befe9`; line numbers are approximate.
1. `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` about `:1548`–`:1566`: the 422 / `INVALID_METADATA` branch. **Measured.**
2. The same file, about `:1534`–`:1536`: the 409 `DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE` branch reads `err?.body?.issues` for the confirmation dialog's list. Same mechanism; not measured on the dispatcher shape.
3. `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/EmbeddedItemEditor.tsx` about `:127`–`:128`: an embedded item's parent save maps `err?.body?.issues` into the sub-form. Same mechanism; not measured.

Pin: each site, on both server shapes, through the real component; item 1 asserts the banner is not `[object Object]` and the title names the field.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Each site reads the parsed `MetadataError` (`err.issues`, `err.message`, `err.code`), which already accepts every live shape, instead of re-reading the raw `err.body`.
- PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11378 moves the one shared reader of a refused save (`formatMetadataError`, `formatMetadataIssue`) into `@object-ui/data-objectstack`. Its module-level `extractIssues` is not exported. Whether these sites map through it, or keep their inline SchemaForm mapping and only switch the source field, is the claim's choice; ⛔ no second issue formatter either way.
- No `/meta` protocol change. A `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

Dedupe words: `ResourceEditPage object Object 422` · `dispatcher details.issues ResourceEditPage` · `metadata-admin refused save banner` · `EmbeddedItemEditor body.issues`
